source.title: Fantasy Football 'Do Draft' list: Derrick Henry, Patrick Mahomes among undervalued players to pick
source.author: Eric Karabell
source.summary: Karabell highlights proven veterans and discounted role winners whose prices leave room for useful fantasy returns.
